name: Timeline
description: Interactive timeline visualization for navigating temporal data with zoom and layer visibility controls

components.name: Allow Playback
components.description: When enabled, the timeline shows the play/pause button and the playback speed selector. When disabled, those two controls are removed; the step and skip-to-start/end buttons remain.

components.name: Time Mode
components.description: The finest time step the timeline offers: YEAR, MONTH, DAY or HOUR. The timeline's step dropdown lists every mode from YEAR down to this one and starts on it; the selected step sets how far the step buttons, playback and arrow keys move the time. Defaults to DAY.
